full_judgment: "A) Decree/order be passed holding that the impugned order dated 09-09-99 removing the petitioner from service and the imposition of new penalty of reduction to the lowest stage in the time scale by order dated 28-02-2000 are illegal, void without jurisdiction and of no legal effect upon the petitioner and that the petitioner still in service with all financial benefits".
